no_default.body: module top;bit clk;logic [7:0] d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input seen=d;output driven=d;endclocking initial ##1;endmodule

positive_input.body: module top;bit clk,d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input #2 d;endclocking endmodule

output_step.body: module top;bit clk,d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);output #1step d;endclocking endmodule

blocking_drive.body: module top;bit clk;logic [7:0] d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input seen=d;output driven=d;endclocking initial cb.driven=1;endmodule

input_drive.body: module top;bit clk;logic [7:0] d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input seen=d;output driven=d;endclocking initial cb.seen<=1;endmodule

output_read.body: module top;bit clk;logic [7:0] d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input seen=d;output driven=d;endclocking initial $display("%d",cb.driven);endmodule

selected_drive.body: module top;bit clk;logic [7:0] d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input seen=d;output driven=d;endclocking initial cb.driven[3:0]<=1;endmodule

duplicate_port.body: module top;bit clk,d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input d;output d;endclocking endmodule

duplicate_block.body: module top;bit clk;clocking cb @(posedge clk);endclocking clocking cb @(posedge clk);endclocking endmodule

duplicate_default.body: module top;bit clk;logic [7:0] d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input seen=d;output driven=d;endclocking default clocking cb;default clocking cb;endmodule

vector_clock.body: module top;logic[2:0] clk;clocking cb @(posedge clk);endclocking endmodule

mixed_event.body: module top;bit clk;logic [7:0] d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input seen=d;output driven=d;endclocking initial @(cb or posedge clk);endmodule

zero_cycles.body: module top;bit clk;logic [7:0] d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input seen=d;output driven=d;endclocking default clocking cb;initial ##0;endmodule

dynamic_cycles.body: module top;bit clk;logic [7:0] d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input seen=d;output driven=d;endclocking default clocking cb;int n=2;initial ##(n);endmodule

clocking_method.body: module top;bit clk;logic [7:0] d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input seen=d;output driven=d;endclocking initial cb.seen();endmodule

timed_drive.body: module top;bit clk;logic [7:0] d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input seen=d;output driven=d;endclocking initial cb.driven<=#1 2;endmodule

net_output.body: module top;bit clk;wire d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);output d;endclocking endmodule

side_effect.body: module top;bit clk,d;clocking cb @(posedge clk);input bad=d++;endclocking endmodule

bad_label.body: module top;bit clk;clocking cb @(posedge clk);endclocking: otherendmodule
